title: Guardrail
description: PROPOSED — needs sign-off from the pricing-agent owner before anything is built against it. Published by dashboard-api to retail/guardrail/{product_id} when a manager changes the allowed price band for a SKU. QoS 1, retained. This is the human-override path: the RL agent must clamp its action to this band, which is what makes the system deployable rather than a demo.

min_price.description: Floor. The agent must never publish a price below this.

max_price.description: Ceiling. The agent must never publish a price above this. Must be >= min_price; the API rejects the request otherwise.

set_by.description: Username of the manager who set the band. Feeds the audit log.
